name: gpt-audio-plugin
description: Generate and edit music with hosted ACE-Step 1.5 on Runware, with Replicate-backed listening for grounded music analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Generate/edit with ACE-Step 1.5 or analyze attached audio.
interface.longDescription: GPTAudioMCP 0.8.0 routes music generation and reference-audio editing to hosted ACE-Step 1.5 on Runware (XL Turbo by default, XL Base available for higher-quality edits). Listening and critique remain on the connected Replicate audio model, so generation no longer requires a user Replicate credential.
defaultPrompt: Generate music from our current conversation.
Listen to the audio file I attached and critique the arrangement, instrumentation, structure, mood, and production.
Use the audio file I attached and our conversation as the creative direction.
